title: Infernux v0.3.4 · Full Engine Update
summary: Version 0.3.4 is the largest Infernux release so far. It rebuilds the rendering, GPU VFX, editor interaction, asset, runtime, physics, and Player distribution paths around explicit ownership and production-facing workflows while keeping Python as the public gameplay and tooling layer.

items.title: A programmable RenderStack and RenderGraph foundation now supports Forward, Forward+, and Deferred routes, reusable Effect assets, explicit stage mount points, custom pipelines, and per-camera render state.
items.text: A programmable RenderStack and RenderGraph foundation now supports Forward, Forward+, and Deferred routes, reusable Effect assets, explicit stage mount points, custom pipelines, and per-camera render state.

items.title: GPU Particle Graph now covers typed graph authoring, AOT graph-to-IR compilation, sprite, mesh, and ribbon outputs, events, continuations, sorting, culling, soft particles, and six-way lit smoke foundations.
items.text: GPU Particle Graph now covers typed graph authoring, AOT graph-to-IR compilation, sprite, mesh, and ribbon outputs, events, continuations, sorting, culling, soft particles, and six-way lit smoke foundations.

items.title: The editor now shares one interaction core for commands, shortcuts, selection, focus, documents, save/close transactions, dirty state, and undo/redo across Scene, Project, Inspector, Timeline, animation, FSM, and graph workflows.
items.text: The editor now shares one interaction core for commands, shortcuts, selection, focus, documents, save/close transactions, dirty state, and undo/redo across Scene, Project, Inspector, Timeline, animation, FSM, and graph workflows.

items.title: The asset system now treats GUID identity and Library artifacts as the durable contract, preserving references across moves and renames and separating authoring data from Player content.
items.text: The asset system now treats GUID identity and Library artifacts as the durable contract, preserving references across moves and renames and separating authoring data from Player content.

items.title: Standalone games use a native launcher, a private Python runtime, compressed Content.inxpkg, packaged runtime shader sources and engine assets, and no editor services.
items.text: Standalone games use a native launcher, a private Python runtime, compressed Content.inxpkg, packaged runtime shader sources and engine assets, and no editor services.

items.title: Added programmable Python RenderStack pipelines with ordered Effect and EffectGroup assets, explicit render stages, runtime parameter updates, and failure-safe fallback behavior.
items.text: Added programmable Python RenderStack pipelines with ordered Effect and EffectGroup assets, explicit render stages, runtime parameter updates, and failure-safe fallback behavior.

items.title: Unified Forward, Forward+, and Deferred geometry submission around the same material, lighting, shadow, and camera contracts.
items.text: Unified Forward, Forward+, and Deferred geometry submission around the same material, lighting, shadow, and camera contracts.

items.title: Added typed RenderGraph resources and passes, structural compilation caching, transient resource aliasing, explicit synchronization intents, renderer-list resources, and frame-safe retirement.
items.text: Added typed RenderGraph resources and passes, structural compilation caching, transient resource aliasing, explicit synchronization intents, renderer-list resources, and frame-safe retirement.

items.title: Added structured GLSL stage metadata and interface linking so materials can author vertex, fragment, and shading-model responsibilities without manually maintaining descriptor layouts.
items.text: Added structured GLSL stage metadata and interface linking so materials can author vertex, fragment, and shading-model responsibilities without manually maintaining descriptor layouts.

items.title: Added reusable geometry-buffer requests for depth, normal, base color, motion, and project-defined buffers, including named sampling from specific passes.
items.text: Added reusable geometry-buffer requests for depth, normal, base color, motion, and project-defined buffers, including named sampling from specific passes.

items.title: Isolated camera culling, shadows, render targets, and lighting resources so Scene, Game, preview, and runtime cameras no longer share mutable per-frame state.
items.text: Isolated camera culling, shadows, render targets, and lighting resources so Scene, Game, preview, and runtime cameras no longer share mutable per-frame state.

items.title: Added Forward+ tiled light lists, canonical GPU light data, light masks, particle lighting, and linked material surfaces.
items.text: Added Forward+ tiled light lists, canonical GPU light data, light masks, particle lighting, and linked material surfaces.

items.title: Improved shadow stability, cascade behavior, resource lifetime, MSAA routing, display encoding, fullscreen effects, outline, picking, gizmos, previews, and packaged-player render parity.
items.text: Improved shadow stability, cascade behavior, resource lifetime, MSAA routing, display encoding, fullscreen effects, outline, picking, gizmos, previews, and packaged-player render parity.

items.title: Added engine-native capture for the editor, individual views, and game cameras.
items.text: Added engine-native capture for the editor, individual views, and game cameras.

items.title: Replaced the public CPU/GPU split with a GPU-first particle workflow and retained one authoring model for emitter settings, Init, Update, events, and Rendering stages.
items.text: Replaced the public CPU/GPU split with a GPU-first particle workflow and retained one authoring model for emitter settings, Init, Update, events, and Rendering stages.

items.title: Added a typed common graph core, Particle Graph editor, node defaults, typed attributes, curves, gradients, noise, conditionals, normalized age, rotation and size over life, and runtime-exposed parameters.
items.text: Added a typed common graph core, Particle Graph editor, node defaults, typed attributes, curves, gradients, noise, conditionals, normalized age, rotation and size over life, and runtime-exposed parameters.

items.title: Added sprite, static-mesh, and GPU-resident ribbon outputs with live materials, textures, alignment, UV controls, flipbook foundations, sorting, indirect drawing, and per-view culling.
items.text: Added sprite, static-mesh, and GPU-resident ribbon outputs with live materials, textures, alignment, UV controls, flipbook foundations, sorting, indirect drawing, and per-view culling.

items.title: Added typed GPU event payloads, event routing, indirect spawning, continuations, waits, and graph-owned lifecycle state.
items.text: Added typed GPU event payloads, event routing, indirect spawning, continuations, waits, and graph-owned lifecycle state.

items.title: Added plane, sphere, surface, vector-field, signed-distance-volume, skin-pose, and scene-depth interaction foundations.
items.text: Added plane, sphere, surface, vector-field, signed-distance-volume, skin-pose, and scene-depth interaction foundations.

items.title: Added soft particles, six-way lit smoke support, emitter lifecycle controls, Scene/Game preview, selection, gizmos, bounds, diagnostics, and scheduling telemetry.
items.text: Added soft particles, six-way lit smoke support, emitter lifecycle controls, Scene/Game preview, selection, gizmos, bounds, diagnostics, and scheduling telemetry.

items.title: Added revisioned Scene and Component documents with stable object and component identities, validation, transactional publication, rollback, and missing-script recovery.
items.text: Added revisioned Scene and Component documents with stable object and component identities, validation, transactional publication, rollback, and missing-script recovery.

items.title: Added indexed asset records, dependency tracking, durable GUID references, asynchronous refresh arbitration, conflict-aware atomic writes, and current-disk reload semantics.
items.text: Added indexed asset records, dependency tracking, durable GUID references, asynchronous refresh arbitration, conflict-aware atomic writes, and current-disk reload semantics.

items.title: Asset moves and renames now preserve references without requiring path-based runtime resolution.
items.text: Asset moves and renames now preserve references without requiring path-based runtime resolution.

items.text: Expanded model, texture, shader, audio, material, prefab, animation, VFX, and physical-material import and preview paths.

items.text: Added artifact-backed texture formats, mip generation, compression settings, GPU-correct previews, and broader common image, model, and audio format handling.

items.text: Removed legacy serialization and shader syntax paths in favor of current schemas and explicit migration errors.

items.text: Added a global command and shortcut router with panel-aware focus and Play-mode editing support.

items.title: Added authoritative global selection across Hierarchy, Scene, Project, Inspector, UI, Timeline, Console, FSM, and node-based editors.
items.text: Added authoritative global selection across Hierarchy, Scene, Project, Inspector, UI, Timeline, Console, FSM, and node-based editors.

items.text: Added a global action journal with transaction-aware undo/redo for scene edits, asset operations, component operations, document navigation, Timeline keys, graph edits, and UI authoring.

items.text: Unified Save, Save As, Discard, Cancel, close, exit, external-change arbitration, and dirty-state ownership across authoring windows.

items.text: Rebuilt common Node Graph foundations for connection handling, dynamic node rebuilding, selection, parameters, contextual commands, and undo integration used by Particle Graph and animation FSM authoring.

items.text: Improved Python component hot reload so method bodies and serialized fields can update during Play without replaying lifecycle entry points.

items.text: Added safer runtime component proxies, lifecycle dispatch, coroutine waits, WaitForEndOfFrame, deferred scene loading, and scene-request generation control.

items.text: Improved Jolt rigidbody synchronization, physical materials, collider shapes, fixed-step behavior, interpolation, collision callbacks, and coherent shadow/visible-transform submission.

items.text: Packaged built-in and project shader sources, Effects, custom pipelines, display encoding, fullscreen passes, and other runtime-only render dependencies required for editor/Player parity.
